summary.text: Kathy Frelich is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 15 since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Frelich earned a B.A. in human resources and social services, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a hearing outreach specialist with the North Dakota School for the Deaf.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as the House Human Services Committee and the House Transportation Committee.
